text: You float in the open sea, eighteen metres down, and hear the way an animal there might. Sound carries for kilometres in water – whales sing from many kilometres away, every call arrives several times via the surface and the seabed and rolls on for a long time. Dolphins pass, the reef crackles in the distance, and once a whale swims right past you.

gruppen.name: riff
gruppen.text: Distant crackling from the reef and the hiss of the surface, from every direction.

gruppen.name: delfine
gruppen.text: A group of dolphins passes 20 to 150 metres away, whistling and clicking; the whistles arrive several times via the surface and the seabed.

gruppen.name: delfin_nah
gruppen.text: Two or three times per loop, a dolphin shoots past close to you.

gruppen.name: wale
gruppen.text: Humpback whales singing from 1.5 to 9 kilometres away – sound carries that far in water, and every call rolls on for a long time.

gruppen.name: wal_nah
gruppen.text: Once per loop a whale glides past a few metres away, singing deep and long.

drehbuch: The dolphins move on; the whales come closer, their song grows fuller.
A whale swims close past you.
The whales drift off into the distance again.
Silent expanse; very far away a whale sings – its song comes from many kilometres off.
A group of dolphins comes by, whistling and clicking.
